HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 21.04.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

This is petition seeking following prayers:
"a. direction to the Respondents, the SHO of P.S. Lajpat Nagar, investigation officer in FIR No. 400/2014, U/s 420/468/471/120B of IPC to defer the arrest of the petitioner until collection of credible evidence sufficient for filing the chargesheet by following the amended proviso to sections 41 (1) (b) and section 41 A Cr.P.C. and also issue the direction to the SHO P.S. Lajpat Nagar i.e. the respondent no. 2 for compliance of provisions of 41 (1) ( b) and 41 A Cr. P.C. in the investigation of the ibid FIR, in the interest of justice."
2.
At the outset, I am of the view that the prayer sought in the petition is not maintainable as it is amounting to grant of bail.
However, Mr Garg, learned counsel for the petitioner states that his only prayer is to ensure that the respondents comply with the provisions of Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
Mr Bhandari, learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of the State.

4. It is a mandate of law that the procedures mentioned in Cr.P.C have to be complied with in letter,
spirit and intent by the Authorities.

In case, the same is not complied, the petitioner is entitled to Rajeev Nag vs State Through Sho And Others on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33852006/
